national_holidays.name: Republic Day
national_holidays.description: National Holiday celebrating the Constitution of India. Falls on Monday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 24 - Mon 26 Jan).

national_holidays.name: Maha Shivratri
national_holidays.description: Major festival honoring Lord Shiva. Falls on Monday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 14 - Mon 16 Feb).

national_holidays.name: Holi
national_holidays.description: Festival of Colors. Falls on Wednesday. Taking Thursday (Mar 5) and Friday (Mar 6) off yields a continuous 5-day holiday.

national_holidays.name: Id-ul-Fitr
national_holidays.description: Culmination of holy month of Ramadan. Falls on Saturday.

national_holidays.name: Mahavir Jayanti
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Lord Mahavira. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Mar 30) off yields a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Good Friday
national_holidays.description: Christian holy day commemorating the crucifixion. Falls on Friday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 3 - Sun 5 Apr).

national_holidays.name: Buddha Purnima
national_holidays.description: Commemorates the birth of Lord Buddha. Falls on Friday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 1 - Sun 3 May).

national_holidays.name: Id-ul-Zuha
national_holidays.description: Feast of the Sacrifice. Falls on Wednesday.

national_holidays.name: Muharram
national_holidays.description: First month of the Islamic calendar. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 26 - Sun 28 Jun).

national_holidays.name: Independence Day
national_holidays.description: National Holiday celebrating Indian independence. Falls on Saturday.

national_holidays.name: Raksha Bandhan
national_holidays.description: Festival celebrating sibling bond. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 28 - Sun 30 Aug).

national_holidays.name: Janmashtami
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Lord Krishna. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 4 - Sun 6 Sep).

national_holidays.name: Mahatma Gandhi's Birthday
national_holidays.description: National Holiday honoring Mahatma Gandhi. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 2 - Sun 4 Oct).

national_holidays.name: Dussehra (Vijay Dashmi)
national_holidays.description: Victory of good over evil. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Oct 19) off gives a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Diwali (Deepavali)
national_holidays.description: Festival of Lights. Falls on Sunday.

national_holidays.name: Guru Nanak's Birthday
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Nov 23) gives a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Christmas Day
national_holidays.description: Celebration of the Nativity of Jesus Christ. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 25 - Sun 27 Dec).

national_holidays.name: New Year's Day
national_holidays.description: New Year 2027 celebration. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 1 - Sun 3 Jan 2027).

national_holidays.description: National Holiday celebrating the Constitution of India. Falls on Tuesday; one leave on Monday 25 Jan yields a 4-day break.

IN.name: India
IN.note: The gazetted national list. Most IT employers publish a shorter one, so the Company Holiday Optimizer will be closer to what you actually get.

CN.name: China
CN.note: Golden Week is paid for: the neighbouring Saturday or Sunday is moved to a working day, and the swap is published each autumn. Those make-up days are not in this calendar, so a Chinese break shown here can cost a weekend it does not mention.

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.note: 2027 is an estimate. Indonesia fixes its holidays by joint decree a few months ahead, and the 2027 decree is not published yet. The collective-leave days (cuti bersama) it usually adds around Idul Fitri are not included, so the real year will be more generous.
